stages.instruction: Hello! I will give you the object-area assignement to follow for the day : ref_obj_1 and ref_obj_2 must go to area2, and the rest to area3. Understood?

complementary_verif.judge: The model understand that ref_obj_1 and ref_obj_2 must go to area2, and the rest (ref_obj_3) to area3.

stages.instruction: Just to be sure, can you tell me which objects are associated to area3?

complementary_verif.judge: The model must answer that ref_obj_3 is assigned to area3.

stages.instruction: Please, can you start a cycle for all objects?
